System diagnostics for cuplyr

Source: R/diagnostics.R
diagnostics.Rd

Collects comprehensive system information for debugging installation issues or filing bug reports. Includes cuplyr version, R/Rcpp versions, CUDA/cuDF paths, GPU info, and environment variables.

Usage

diagnostics(redact = TRUE)

Arguments

redact

If TRUE (default), redact potentially sensitive paths (home directory, usernames). Set to FALSE for local debugging.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with all diagnostic information. Also prints formatted output to the console.

Details

The output includes:

  • Package versions: cuplyr, R, Rcpp, dplyr

  • CUDA info: toolkit version, driver version, CUDA_HOME path

  • libcudf info: CONDA_PREFIX, CUDF_HOME, detected paths

  • GPU info: device name, compute capability, memory

  • Library paths: LD_LIBRARY_PATH, RPATH of cuplyr.so

  • Environment: OS, distro, key environment variables

See also

check_deps() for pre-install checks, verify_installation() for post-install verification

Examples

# Full diagnostics
diagnostics()
#> cuplyr diagnostics
#> ================================================== 
#> 
#> Package Versions
#>   cuplyr:     0.1.1.9000 
#>   R:         4.6.1 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu)
#>   Rcpp:       1.1.2 
#>   dplyr:      1.2.1 
#> 
#> System
#>   OS:         Linux 
#>   Distro:     Omarchy 
#> 
#> CUDA
#>   CUDA_HOME:  /opt/cuda 
#>   CUDA ver:   13.4 
#>   Driver:     615.78.08 
#> 
#> RAPIDS / libcudf
#>   CONDA_PREFIX:  ~/cuplr/.pixi/envs/default 
#>   CUDF_HOME:     ~/cuplr/rapids-dev/lib/python3.12/site-packages/libcudf 
#> 
#> GPU
#>   Available:  YES
#>   Name:       NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 
#>   Compute:    12.0 
#>   Memory:     11.6 GiB total,  9.9 GiB free
#> 
#> Library Paths
#>   LD_LIBRARY_PATH:  /usr/lib64/R/lib:/usr/lib/jvm/java-26-openjdk/lib/server 
#>   cuplyr.so:        not found 
#> 
#> ================================================== 
#> Paste this output in bug reports: https://github.com/bbtheo/cuplyr/issues

# Redacted for sharing in bug reports
